title: Kubernetes Ingress/Gateway Compiler
description: Compiles Kubernetes Ingress, Gateway API, and HTTPRoute manifests. Enforces: every backend service/port resolves, hostnames valid and unique, TLS secret refs exist and hostnames match route hosts.

error_codes.KI001: k8s-ingress-spec.json missing or invalid — required: name, rules[]
error_codes.KI002: Backend service/port does not resolve to a declared Service
error_codes.KI003: Hostname is not a valid FQDN or is not unique within route scope
error_codes.KI004: TLS secret hostnames do not match route host rules
error_codes.KI005: Path match type or rule structure is invalid
